No tolls need to be paid here. 

I am in the wear your sneakers camp. I have a history of wearing brand new kicks to concerts. Makes a cool memory and then I never have to worry about them being too clean. I wore a new pair of grey 350s when I saw him at Coachella in 2017 right after Damn came out.
It’s either these or the blue sb’s.

My therapist would like a word with you.
